map.算法（GB 150 内压圆筒）：计算壁厚 δ = P×Di/(2[σ]φ − P: Algorithm (GB 150 internal pressure cylinder): compute the thickness δ = P×Di/(2[σ]φ − P); design thickness δd = δ + C₂ (corrosion allowance); nominal thickness rounded up to δn = ⌈(δd + C₁)×2⌉/2, where C₁ = 0.3 mm is the material negative deviation, and…
map.按设计压力与内径计算所需壁厚并圆整到名义厚度: Compute the required wall thickness from the design pressure and internal diameter and round up to a nominal thickness
map.叠加腐蚀裕量与材料负偏差: Add the corrosion allowance and material negative deviation
map.反算名义壁厚下的最大允许工作压力 MAWP: Back-calculate the maximum allowable working pressure MAWP for a nominal thickness
map.输出应力利用率与用钢量: Output the stress utilization and steel weight

map.焊缝系数：双面焊 100% 无损检测取 1.0、局部 0.85、不做 0.6，降: Weld coefficient: 1.0 for double-sided welds with 100% nondestructive testing, 0.85 with partial testing, 0.6 with none — a lower test ratio raises the wall thickness
map.腐蚀裕量 C₂ 按设计年限×腐蚀速率定（常 1~3mm），负偏差 C₁ 为钢板厚: The corrosion allowance C₂ is set by design life × corrosion rate (typically 1–3 mm), and the negative deviation C₁ is the lower deviation of the steel plate thickness
map.名义壁厚须圆整至标准规格并保证 MAWP ≥ 设计压力: The nominal thickness must be rounded up to a standard size and ensure MAWP ≥ design pressure
map.盛装液化气、有外压或开孔补强时须另按 GB 150 相应条款校核: For liquefied gas, external pressure, or opening reinforcement, check separately against the relevant GB 150 clauses
map.焊缝系数 φ 怎么取？: How Is the Weld Coefficient φ Chosen?
map.φ 反映焊接接头强度相对母材的折减：双面焊对接接头 100% 无损检测取 1.0: φ reflects the derating of the welded joint strength relative to the parent metal: 1.0 for a double-sided butt weld with 100% nondestructive testing, 0.85 with partial testing, and 0.6 with none. GB 150 sets the value by joint type and test coverage, and a lower test ratio directly raises the wall thickness and cost.
map.为什么算出来还要加腐蚀裕量和负偏差？: Why Add Corrosion Allowance and Negative Deviation on Top of the Computed Thickness?
map.计算壁厚只保证承压强度。腐蚀裕量 C₂ 是为介质腐蚀预留的使用寿命厚度（按设计年: The computed thickness only guarantees pressure strength. The corrosion allowance C₂ reserves service-life thickness for media corrosion (set by design life × corrosion rate, typically 1–3 mm), and the material negative deviation C₁ is the allowed lower deviation of the steel plate. Both must be added outside the strength calculation, or the vessel loses strength later in service as it thins.
